P.flaw: A large empty gap sits above the button, and the order number is set with odd spacing as 'RX - 48213', so the key data looks loose.

Q.flaw: The white-on-dark header band and the three styles of detail row (plain, boxed, bold) are slightly inconsistent, though still clear.

ui-1.why_top: Q makes the order number, Window 2 and the copay stand out with strong contrast and clear grouping, so a 72-year-old at the counter can find what the pharmacist needs at once.

P.flaw: Cancel and Snooze sit side by side at the top, and Snooze is a bare text link whose tap area is hard to judge.

Q.flaw: Cancel is a large, easy-to-hit amber button with only a short gap above Snooze, and it needs no hold, so a sleepy thumb can trigger it by accident.

ui-2.why_top: P guards Cancel with a visible press-and-hold and a clear gap from Snooze, and its large amber 7 stays dominant in a dim bus.
